transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess it’s mostly work stuff. I know this might sound kind of… paranoid or maybe I’m reading into it too much, but I’ve been feeling like people at work—and even some of the vendors—are tracking what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid.

My supervisor has shown me reports that don’t really prove that’s happening, and I get that. I’m trying not to make a big thing out of it. But I can’t really shake the feeling, and it’s been bothering me enough that I thought I should come in and talk to someone, if that makes sense.
Have you had any other thoughts or feelings lately where you’ve felt like people are trying to harm you or control things in ways that don’t make sense to others?

I mean… not really like someone’s going to physically hurt me, I don’t think. It’s more that I keep feeling like at work people are… controlling the situation, I guess. Like the vendors or people there are watching what I buy and then the launch numbers come out weird so I look bad.

I know my supervisor showed me reports and they don’t really prove that, so I’m trying to be reasonable about it. But the feeling keeps sticking, and I can’t tell if I’m just overthinking it. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you noticed any situations outside of work where you feel like things are being controlled or directed in a way that feels strange or targeted toward you?

Not really outside of work, no… at least not that I can point to. It’s mostly the work stuff that I keep getting stuck on — like people there, and even some vendors, somehow tracking my buys and then the launch numbers coming out messed up so I look bad.

I know that probably sounds like I’m making connections that aren’t there, and my supervisor has shown me reports that don’t prove it. I’m trying to keep that in mind. But that feeling is kind of the main thing I haven’t been able to shake. Does that make sense?
Have you ever had any unusual thoughts or beliefs that you think others might not understand or would find strange, even if they don’t involve work?

I don’t think so… I mean, not outside of the work thing. That’s really the main one, and I know it sounds strange when I say it out loud.

It’s just that I can’t shake this feeling that people at work, and maybe even some vendors, are tracking what I buy and then somehow messing with the launch numbers so I end up looking stupid. My supervisor has shown me reports that don’t really prove that’s happening, so I’m trying to be fair about it. But it still feels hard to let go of. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever believed something to be true that others strongly disagreed with, even when there was clear evidence against it, outside of this work situation?

No, I don’t think so… outside of the work thing, I can’t really think of anything like that.

I mean, I might get stubborn about normal stuff sometimes, but not where people are showing me clear proof and I’m still convinced, if that makes sense. The work situation is really the only thing that’s felt… hard to drop. Is that answering it right?
Have you ever had any beliefs or ideas that you know others might find odd or hard to believe, even if they’re not related to work or how people are treating you there?

Honestly, I’m kind of embarrassed to say it again because I know it probably sounds odd… but it’s mostly that same thing.

Like, what really pushed me to come in is I can’t shake this feeling that people at work — and maybe even some vendors — are tracking what I buy and then messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. And I know my supervisor has shown me reports that don’t really prove that’s happening, so I’m trying not to just insist I’m right.

Outside of that, though, I don’t think I have other beliefs like that. Is that what you’re asking?

Even though your supervisor has shown you reports that don’t support this, do you still believe, deep down, that people at work and vendors are tracking your purchases and manipulating the launch numbers to make you look bad?

Yeah… I mean, I know the reports don’t prove it, and I don’t want to sound like I’m just ignoring what he showed me. But deep down, it still feels like something is going on.

I keep coming back to the idea that people at work, and maybe some vendors too, are tracking what I’m buying and then somehow messing with the launch numbers so I look bad or stupid. I know that probably sounds like a lot, but I can’t really shake it. That’s honestly why I came in.
Even though there’s no proof and others have shown you different information, do you still feel certain that this is really happening, or do you sometimes doubt it?

I do doubt it sometimes… especially when he shows me the reports and I’m sitting there thinking, okay, maybe I’m making connections that aren’t there.

But then, deep down, I still can’t really shake it. It still feels like people at work — and maybe even vendors — are tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. I know there’s not proof, and I’m trying to be reasonable about it, but the feeling doesn’t go away. Does that make sense?

When you say you still can't shake the feeling, does it feel like a strong, unshakable belief to you — like you just know it's true, even if you can't prove it — or more like a nagging worry that keeps coming back?

I guess… I want to say it’s just a nagging worry, because that sounds more reasonable.

But if I’m being honest, it feels stronger than that a lot of the time. Like deep down I feel like I know something is happening — that people at work, and maybe vendors, are tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. Even when my supervisor shows me reports that don’t really prove it, I still can’t let it go.

I know that probably sounds bad, but that’s the thing that made me come in.
